thread:
pagerbot: [P1] gcp-us-west2: GPU pool exhausted; autoscaler stalled. queue growth +3100, errors: quotaExceeded. triggered ~00:02 ago.

sam: seeing large inference queue and rising 503s on hosted endpoints. trying retries.

alex: i'm on call, starting an ops bridge. paging infra-oncall. @mike please prep customer comms. :rotating_light:

mike: will draft banner and ping CSMs.

rohit: infra note — GCP quota API returning 403 for new accelerator creates: "RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED". attempting region fallback to us-west4.

zara: metrics: p50 p99 both spiking, error budget now ~14%. NA customers report failures, spike concentrated in high-concurrency routes.

alex: runbook step -> region-fallback. rohit, kick the fallback job: `k run fallback --region=us-west4 --model=redwood-small-quant`

rohit: kicked fallback job; pods are Pending with `Insufficient accelerators`. opening GCP support case and escalating.

sam: temporary mitigation: enabling model downscaling for non-critical routes and lowering concurrency for free tier. patching router to prefer dedicated pool fallback.

alex: applied routing patch -> `service-router` update: `fallback_priority: [dedicated-eu-west1, hosted-us-west4]`; rolling.

ops-bot: autoscaler logs snapshot: `scaleUpAttempts=7, lastError=QuotaExceeded, backoff=30s, pendingPods=42`

zara: customer-impact: ~12 customers experienced 5xxs in last 10m; top impacted tenant `acme-pay` showing steady failures. CS team notified.

mike: CS update sent, soft outage message; ETA communicated 30-45m while we failover and request quota. CSM @jess looped.

jess: acknowledged, preparing outreach and potential credit template.

rohit: GCP support reply (case 987654321): they see quota limits, estimated 2-6h for increase unless expedited. requested quota override now.

alex: escalating to PL and ops leadership. enabling temporary allocation rebalancing: evict low-priority background jobs to preemptible pools. running `k scale --selector=priority=low --replicas=0`.

sam: performing eviction and draining low-priority queues; also reducing inference concurrency for free-tier by 50%. should free some GPUs for critical traffic.

pagerbot: NOTE: no customer data exposure detected. severity remains P1. on-call handoff scheduled in 30m to @alex if unresolved.

zara: incident tracking doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/incident/INC-2026-342 (internal).

alex: executive summary: region GPU quota hit prevented scale-up; primary mitigations = region failover, model downscaling, preemptible eviction, quota request. next update in 15m. :thumbsup:
